headline: US Treasury yields surge, financial bonds also 'jump'... card companies' funding costs on alert
summary: US long-term Treasury yields and Korean government bond yields rose to their highest levels in 19 years. Yields on card-company specialty bonds have also climbed into the 4% range.
why: Treasury yields are the benchmark for global borrowing costs, and card companies rely on specialty bond issuance to fund their lending.
